_comment: Per-item manual position nudges for swf_to_spritesheet.py. Applied on top of whatever the item's slot formula computes -- use this when one specific item doesn't fit the formula, not as a replacement for the formula. See the ANCHOR_OVERRIDES_PATH comment in swf_to_spritesheet.py for the full story.
_format: item_id: {"dx": N, "dy": N} applies to every direction; add "dirs": {"<direction>": {"dx": N, "dy": N}} for a single direction that's off on its own (added on top of dx/dy, not instead of). Units: 3x-canvas px.
